description: This file defines the InternalReporter class for handling test reporting, including methods for configuration, test lifecycle events, error handling, and adding code snippets to errors. It also includes a utility function to add source code snippets to errors based on file locations.

classes.name: InternalReporter
classes.description: A class implementing the ReporterV2 interface for internal test reporting, managing reporter lifecycle, error processing, and integrating source code snippets into errors.

methods.name: addLocationAndSnippetToError
methods.description: Adds source code snippets and location info to a TestError object based on its stack trace and file location.
